review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: Base, raw, protected final, guide, edit mask, protection mask, and automated composite report were inspected independently.
review_views.notes: The two main massifs read as dark relief patches, but four detached foothills do not survive as a six-part terrain hierarchy.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The 1536x1024 final was inspected at native scale.
review_views.notes: Orthographic relief replaces the G1 scenic peaks, while long parallel bands and road-shaped quiet channels are already visible.

review_views.label: 200%・400%拡大
review_views.evidence: Twenty final/raw diagnostic crops under tmp/map-production/g2-review-v1 were inspected at original detail.
review_views.notes: Magnification exposes fingerprint-like repetition, missing foothill structure, and abrupt hachure termination beside protected roads.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: The full final and 8x amplified base/final difference were scanned across all edges and regions.
review_views.notes: All four outer borders are unchanged; the defects are confined to the intended north-east and south-east relief areas.

review_views.label: 制御図との半透明重ね合わせ
review_views.evidence: The six-component topology guide, final difference, edit mask, protection mask, and per-component difference statistics were compared.
review_views.notes: NE-west and SE-east foothills retain only 17.7% and 15.2% of pixels above a 5-level mean difference; all four foothills fail reliable independent recognition.

review_views.label: 親ズーム画像との比較
review_views.evidence: Candidate D v4 and G2 were compared at matching extents and reduced visual scale.
review_views.notes: Palette and paper texture continue, but the massifs collapse into dark patches and the foothills disappear at parent scale.

review_views.label: 四方向の隣接合成
review_views.evidence: All outer border differences are zero and north-east/south-east edge crops were inspected.
review_views.notes: No canvas-edge clipping remains, but internal road guards create visible terrain discontinuities that read as mask seams.

review_views.label: ベクターラベル・道路・POI重畳
review_views.evidence: Roads, city wall, coast, fields, trees, future label quiet space, and protected-pixel evidence were reviewed.
review_views.notes: Protected linework remains exact, while dense repetitive relief competes with labels and broad road-shaped gaps call attention to the mask.

review_views.label: Leafletデスクトップ表示
review_views.evidence: Desktop suitability was assessed from the native overview and 200% crops; staging was stopped by hard image failures.
review_views.notes: Main relief is legible but reads as repeated contour bands rather than a detailed historical terrain layer.

review_views.label: Leafletモバイル表示
review_views.evidence: Mobile suitability was assessed from the full overview at reduced visual scale; staging was stopped by hard image failures.
review_views.notes: Only two dark massifs remain, so the six-landform topology is lost.

immediate_failures.label: 海岸線・河川・主要道路・城壁の移動
immediate_failures.evidence: Automated gates and visual comparison show zero changed pixels outside permission, on road cores, on detail cores, and on all four canvas borders.

immediate_failures.label: 必須地点・地形の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: Only the two main massifs are reliable; the four required detached foothills are absent or merge into existing rock texture at 100%, 200%, and 400%.

immediate_failures.label: 正典外の主要都市・施設
immediate_failures.evidence: No new city, facility, road, or major landmark was introduced.

immediate_failures.label: AI生成文字・記号
immediate_failures.evidence: No words, pseudo-writing, compass, scale bar, legend, signature, or route-like generated marks were found.

immediate_failures.label: 目視できる継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: Protected road corridors appear as broad flat channels where hachures stop abruptly, producing mask-derived halos and terrain cuts.

immediate_failures.label: 現代物・透かし・署名
immediate_failures.evidence: No modern object, watermark, logo, or signature was found.

immediate_failures.label: 遠近法化・縮尺の急変
immediate_failures.evidence: No triangular scenic peaks, side faces, directional cast shadows, horizon, or oblique projection remain.

immediate_failures.label: 建物・樹木・岩の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: Long, evenly spaced, near-parallel wavy lines repeat across both massifs and read as fingerprint or contour bands instead of short irregular fall-line hachures.

scores.label: 正典・地形形状との一致
scores.notes: Protected canon is exact, but four foothills and clear saddle hierarchy are missing.

scores.label: 親子ズームの連続性
scores.notes: Palette continues; main relief collapses into dark patches and foothills disappear when reduced.

scores.label: 隣接画像の継ぎ目
scores.notes: Outer edges are exact, but protected road corridors visibly sever the relief.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: Strict plan view is successful; continuous regular waves violate the requested short irregular hachure grammar.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Two massifs are over-dense while the four secondary landforms are too faint.

scores.label: 生成破綻・反復模様
scores.notes: Fingerprint-like repetition and mask-derived road channels are dominant artifacts.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Exact protection helps, but dense repeated bands compete with labels and POIs.

summary: G2 removes G1 perspective and edge clipping, but is rejected because four required foothills disappear, long uniform contour-like bands repeat across both massifs, and protected roads read as flat mask channels.
required_changes: Replace long continuous parallel waves with short, broken, unequal fall-line strokes while keeping the orthographic viewpoint, base, palette, and protected canon fixed.
Use a deterministic six-landform hachure skeleton so every foothill, two-lobe massif, and quiet saddle exists in the raw generation before compositing.
